randomization.candidates: five built-in views plus locally uploaded custom image if available

scenery.frame: continuous glazing behind paper-painted arch, crossbars and sill

returnInteraction.scene: tap blank scene to fold and put away; writing only blurs

paperPlacement.anchor: open book center, constrained within viewport
paperPlacement.motion: center stays fixed as paper unfolds or folds; original dock return

music.firstGramophoneTap: opens sheet and starts selected record
music.notes: float continuously while idle or playing; pause with paused/error audio; reduced motion supported

cushions.left: plump sage-green lumbar with warm-white polka dots and cream piping

floorLamp.interaction: pull 22px then release to toggle; short pull rebounds; tap/keyboard supported

bouquet.interaction: touch or hover to sway; damped branches around a fixed vase; reduced-motion respected
bouquet.vase: tap to cycle original/tulips/daisies, crossfade above fixed vase

secrets.scope: this browser only; no cross-player publication

revisit.author: per-note and per-reply
revisit.readState: per reader, front and revealed replies
revisit.initialSelection: own new replies first, then stable opening paper preferring unseen others; all remaining papers accessible by page turn
revisit.playtest: ?playtest=revisit&reader=A|B|N; isolated local simulation, no network sharing
revisit.paperPresentation: one note per page; every paper in a book is reachable, own paper stays on its own page; right-edge corner navigation unchanged
revisit.ownWriting: add a line to yourself; foreign notes accept replies

discovery.pool: 44 reviewed historical group excerpts in 30 real books; unchanged cat and legacy fictional fixtures retained
discovery.revisit: fully read current paper and replies then return before advancing the opening selection; page turns can browse all paper at any time
discovery.refresh: keeps selected opening page and reading progress; no inactivity expiry
discovery.availability: all papers in a book, including unknown, known and own; no random access gate
discovery.openingSelection: one stable random unseen-other opening page, read-and-return permits advancing; own new replies first
discovery.legacySaves: old null offers, found counters and quiet flags do not block existing notes

collection.cat: unchanged sprite, source coordinates, content and original mechanism

insideCover.ordinaryNoteLayout: passage or synopsis on left; active note opens and scrolls on right without overlap
insideCover.selection: verified excerpt associated with active paper and matching book, otherwise synopsis
insideCover.longExcerpt: scroll within left paper without closing the book

camera.interaction: native touch panning and mouse dragging

stacks.motion: upper books settle into removed book space; rise before reinsertion
stacks.orientation: horizontal side spines and visible page edges

arrangement.piles: direct tap on a visible spine picks that specific book; no fan/chooser stage
arrangement.target: 44px button bounds; shared compact pointer areas resolve to nearest visible spine
arrangement.covers: existing illustrated held covers and front prince/lychee/cat retained, upright scene spines use separate plain cloth atlas
arrangement.horizontalArt: small front-spine icons removed from all five colored source books, top cover moon/mountain/leaf/sun/bird retained, existing thick binding geometry
arrangement.titleFont: self-hosted Noto Serif SC400 printed Song/Ming-style titles, dark ink no shadow, glyphs turn with horizontal book; original raster title font not identified, letter font unchanged
arrangement.iconStyle: all31 physical spines have no icons; existing cover illustrations retained
arrangement.titleLayout: upright centered with title-length-aware font size, horizontal title width expanded and font enlarged

authoredKeepsake.storage: static definition outside reader message pool

development.eventRecording: opt-in playtest=rhythm, memory only; enum/count details, no reading text or names
development.replyDrafts: existing per-reader draft object, namespaced by reply:bookId:paperId

bindingRefinement.front: full cloth cover and square flat mark; no widened spine atlas; original cat/prince/lychee illustrated fronts kept
bindingRefinement.horizontalFlight: extract, uniform scale3d and rotate from horizontal tilted pose, reverse for insertion
bindingRefinement.pile: upper books settle only after clearance, lift before reinsertion

princePostcard.source: user supplied image; original PNG bytes preserved
princePostcard.layout: short display frame; CSS crops excess sky and grass with object-fit cover, original PNG unchanged; prince and fox kept
princePostcard.existing: night postcard, real notes, rose envelope and old saves preserved
princePostcard.caption:
你望向星星时，
我就在其中一颗上想你。
princePostcard.captionSource: original game copy inspired by the Little Prince; not a quotation

datedNotes.source: original WeFlow message dates; no invented dates for legacy paper
datedNotes.selection: unread first; prefer another author, then another date, then another sheet; continue revisiting after all are read
datedNotes.stableUntil: complete current paper/replies and return book to shelf

paperFeel.interaction: lift and unfold; swipe right or touch raised paper corner to tuck back; swipe postcard left to turn; reply drafts kept

singleCorner.behavior: one lower-right next corner, wraps last to first; open paper is tucked and draft kept before turning; paper raised and corner kept clear
singleCorner.copy: 放回 / 收起便笺 / 收起信 / 收起草稿

pageCraft.behavior: curved corner and 12-panel paper bend with moving cast shadow; single corner, drafts and old saves preserved

pageFeel.behavior: physical free-edge tracking; recent release velocity and reversal; shorter settling; anonymous folded-paper preview

cornerFinish.appearance: warm paper underside, curved rolled lip, hairline rim and soft contact shadow; existing 76px target and gesture behavior preserved

bouquetPicker.behavior: vase opens gramophone-style paper chooser; choose one of three existing bouquets; hover/touch sway and saved choice preserved

musicDefault.behavior: default playback on entry; restore saved track; policy denial waits for first trusted click or keyboard activation; explicit pause stays paused for this visit

sleepingCat.behavior: one round calico sleeping cat; sofa or stool chosen once on load, stable during visit; subtle breathing and reduced-motion support

authoredStories.source: original fiction from the two approved humorous batches; not group messages or book quotations

catActions.behavior: one random cel animation: low side-to-side tail swish/settle; listening ears/half-eye/blink; curl/side/back/stretch/settle; no pixel deformation or rigid spin

mobileFit.behavior: safe-area and visual-viewport layout, portrait paired reading, wider landscape pages and reachable form actions

flatWindowScenery.generation: built-in image_gen; one call per scene; original generated PNGs copied unchanged
flatWindowScenery.photo: upload entry retained; explicit local photo removal with session undo; no global photo purge
flatWindowScenery.animation: original: gentle leaf sway; rain: slow river ripples; nightSnow: 22 sparse drifting flakes. All clipped, paused offscreen/hidden/reading, static reduced motion.
flatWindowScenery.retired: seaside, sunset, snow removed from UI/random pool/current asset whitelist; old photo data preserved when migrating a retired view

catPictureBook.behavior: independent full front art; three bound illustration pages; old notes and saves retained

limitations: Browser touch emulation; no physical iPhone acceptance
No multiplayer server; local saves are origin-specific
